peak_rush.name: Peak season rush
peak_rush.blurb: The lines bring the peak early. Build a port that works thirty calls inside their windows before the season ends.

storm_week.name: Storm week
storm_week.blurb: Gale after gale is forecast. Keep the berths turning: move 20,000 boxes across the quay through the storms.

automate_or_bust.name: Automate or bust
automate_or_bust.blurb: A rival port has gone driverless and the line is watching. Run twelve AGVs and move 15,000 boxes before they sign with the rival.

angry_neighbours.name: Angry neighbours
angry_neighbours.blurb: Saltmarsh has had enough of the old port. Grow it to 25,000 moves without the town's mood ever falling below 35.
